title: Frangi-Net: A Neural Network Approach to Vessel Segmentation
mechanism: The multi-scale Frangi vesselness filter rewritten as a network with preset weights, so it starts as Frangi and can then be trained end to end.
adaptation: Dark-ridge variant with sigmas 0.7 to 2.5 px, matched to the 4 px FWHM crack line. Used as a trainable input branch concatenated to the raw channel before the ResNet-34 stem.
min_experiment: Arm: house with [raw, learnable dark-ridge Frangi], 5 seeds. Baseline: house. Metric: test relF1@2, E1 crack recall. Kill: E1 recall < +0.03 and relF1@2 < +0.01.
evidence: R: 45 high-resolution fundus images; F1 up to +17% after fine-tuning compared with the fixed filter.
prior_overlap: none in BRIEF section 5. D12 notes that HarmonySeg found vesselness at the input gave no notable gain on 3D hepatic vessels (other domain).

alt_notes.adaptation: Dark-ridge variant, sigma 0.7 to 2.5 px to match the 4 px FWHM crack line; extra input channel or parallel stem branch trained jointly.
alt_notes.min_experiment: Arm: 2-channel [raw, learnable dark-ridge Frangi]; baseline house; 5 seeds; relF1@2, E1 crack recall; kill if E1 recall < +0.03 and test relF1@2 < +0.01.
